name: Plitvice Lakes National Park
description: Plitvice Lakes National Park sits in the mountainous heart of Croatia, close to the Bosnian border. Over thousands of years, mineral-rich water has built natural travertine dams that hold back a chain of lakes linked by waterfalls, with caves tucked among them. The process is still going on today. Beech forests around the water shelter bears, wolves and rare birds.
